steps.say: Every live way in has its own row down here in **Ways in**, with its verbs at the end of it. Find the row for the person who says they never got their invite.

**Email again** sends the same invite a second time. Nothing changes and no new link is made, so the one they may yet dig out of a spam folder still works. Only rows for a named person with an email on file carry this button.
steps.terminal: That's the same invite, sent again — and the note above the table names the address it went to. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
